verses.label: v01
verses.text: If I speak in the tongues of humans and of angels but do not have love, I have become a resounding gong or a clashing cymbal.
lines: If I speak in the tongues of humans and of angels but do not have love, I have become a resounding gong or a clashing cymbal.

verses.label: v02
verses.text: And if I have prophecy and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so as to move mountains but do not have love, I am nothing.
lines: And if I have prophecy and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith so as to move mountains but do not have love, I am nothing.

verses.label: v03
verses.text: And if I give away all my possessions, and if I hand over my body so that I may boast, but do not have love, I gain nothing.
lines: And if I give away all my possessions, and if I hand over my body so that I may boast, but do not have love, I gain nothing.

verses.label: v04
verses.text: Love is patient; love is kind. Love does not envy, does not boast, is not puffed up.
lines: Love is patient; love is kind. Love does not envy, does not boast, is not puffed up.

verses.label: v05
verses.text: It does not behave dishonorably, does not seek its own way, is not easily provoked, and does not keep an account of wrong.
lines: It does not behave dishonorably, does not seek its own way, is not easily provoked, and does not keep an account of wrong.

verses.label: v06
verses.text: It does not rejoice in injustice but rejoices together with the truth.
lines: It does not rejoice in injustice but rejoices together with the truth.

verses.label: v07
verses.text: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
lines: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

verses.label: v08
verses.text: Love never fails. But prophecies will be brought to an end, tongues will cease, and knowledge will be brought to an end.
lines: Love never fails. But prophecies will be brought to an end, tongues will cease, and knowledge will be brought to an end.

verses.label: v09
verses.text: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,
lines: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,

verses.label: v10
verses.text: but when completeness comes, what is partial will be brought to an end.
lines: but when completeness comes, what is partial will be brought to an end.

verses.label: v11
verses.text: When I was a child, I spoke like a child, thought like a child, and reasoned like a child. When I became an adult, I put away childish things.
lines: When I was a child, I spoke like a child, thought like a child, and reasoned like a child. When I became an adult, I put away childish things.

verses.label: v12
verses.text: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part; then I will know fully, just as I have been fully known.
lines: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part; then I will know fully, just as I have been fully known.

verses.label: v13
verses.text: Now faith, hope, and love remain, these three; and the greatest of these is love.
lines: Now faith, hope, and love remain, these three; and the greatest of these is love.

notes.raw_text: Spectacular speech, knowledge, faith, generosity, and bodily surrender are nothing without love.

verses.label: v27
verses.text: Now you are Christ's body, and individually members of it.
lines: Now you are Christ's body, and individually members of it.

verses.label: v28
verses.text: And God has appointed in the church first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healing, helping, leading, and various kinds of tongues.
lines: And God has appointed in the church first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healing, helping, leading, and various kinds of tongues.

verses.label: v29
verses.text: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?
lines: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?

verses.label: v30
verses.text: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?
lines: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?

verses.label: v31
verses.text: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show you a way beyond all comparison.
lines: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show you a way beyond all comparison.

verses.label: v01
verses.text: Pursue love and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially that you may prophesy.
lines: Pursue love and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially that you may prophesy.

verses.label: v02
verses.text: For the one who speaks in a tongue speaks not to people but to God, since no one understands; by the Spirit that person speaks mysteries.
lines: For the one who speaks in a tongue speaks not to people but to God, since no one understands; by the Spirit that person speaks mysteries.

verses.label: v03
verses.text: But the one who prophesies speaks to people for building up, encouragement, and comfort.
lines: But the one who prophesies speaks to people for building up, encouragement, and comfort.

verses.label: v04
verses.text: The one who speaks in a tongue builds up oneself, but the one who prophesies builds up the church.
lines: The one who speaks in a tongue builds up oneself, but the one who prophesies builds up the church.

verses.label: v05
verses.text: Now I want all of you to speak in tongues, but even more to prophesy. The one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in tongues, unless someone interprets so that the church may be built up.

lines: Now I want all of you to speak in tongues, but even more to prophesy. The one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in tongues, unless someone interprets so that the church may be built up.

verses.label: v06
verses.text: Now, brothers and sisters, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you unless I speak to you with a revelation, knowledge, prophecy, or teaching?
lines: Now, brothers and sisters, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you unless I speak to you with a revelation, knowledge, prophecy, or teaching?

verses.label: v07
verses.text: Even lifeless instruments that produce sound, whether flute or harp, if they make no distinction between notes, how will anyone know what is played?
lines: Even lifeless instruments that produce sound, whether flute or harp, if they make no distinction between notes, how will anyone know what is played?

verses.label: v08
verses.text: And if a trumpet gives an unclear sound, who will prepare for battle?
lines: And if a trumpet gives an unclear sound, who will prepare for battle?

verses.label: v09
verses.text: So also with you: unless you give intelligible speech with your tongue, how will anyone know what is being said? You will simply be speaking into the air.
lines: So also with you: unless you give intelligible speech with your tongue, how will anyone know what is being said? You will simply be speaking into the air.

verses.label: v10
verses.text: There are, perhaps, many kinds of languages in the world, and none is without meaning.
lines: There are, perhaps, many kinds of languages in the world, and none is without meaning.

verses.label: v11
verses.text: So if I do not know the meaning of the language, I will be a foreigner to the speaker, and the speaker a foreigner to me.
lines: So if I do not know the meaning of the language, I will be a foreigner to the speaker, and the speaker a foreigner to me.

verses.label: v12
verses.text: So also with you: since you are eager for spiritual manifestations, seek to excel in building up the church.
lines: So also with you: since you are eager for spiritual manifestations, seek to excel in building up the church.

verses.label: v13
verses.text: Therefore, the one who speaks in a tongue should pray to interpret.
lines: Therefore, the one who speaks in a tongue should pray to interpret.

verses.label: v14
verses.text: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.
lines: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.

verses.label: v15
verses.text: What then? I will pray with the spirit, but I will also pray with the mind. I will sing praise with the spirit, but I will also sing praise with the mind.
lines: What then? I will pray with the spirit, but I will also pray with the mind. I will sing praise with the spirit, but I will also sing praise with the mind.

verses.label: v16
verses.text: Otherwise, if you offer praise by the spirit, how can someone in the place of an outsider say “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since that person does not know what you are saying?
lines: Otherwise, if you offer praise by the spirit, how can someone in the place of an outsider say “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since that person does not know what you are saying?

verses.label: v17
verses.text: You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other person is not built up.
lines: You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other person is not built up.

verses.label: v18
verses.text: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.
lines: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.

verses.label: v19
verses.text: But in church I would rather speak five intelligible words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.
lines: But in church I would rather speak five intelligible words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.

verses.label: v20
verses.text: Brothers and sisters, do not be children in your thinking. Be infants in evil, but mature in your thinking.
lines: Brothers and sisters, do not be children in your thinking. Be infants in evil, but mature in your thinking.

verses.label: v21
verses.text: In the law it is written: “By people of other tongues and by the lips of foreigners I will speak to this people, yet even then they will not listen to me,” says the Lord.
lines: In the law it is written: “By people of other tongues and by the lips of foreigners I will speak to this people, yet even then they will not listen to me,” says the Lord.

verses.label: v22
verses.text: So tongues are a sign not for believers but for unbelievers, while prophecy is not for unbelievers but for believers.
lines: So tongues are a sign not for believers but for unbelievers, while prophecy is not for unbelievers but for believers.

verses.label: v23
verses.text: Therefore, if the whole church gathers together and everyone speaks in tongues, and outsiders or unbelievers enter, will they not say you are out of your minds?
lines: Therefore, if the whole church gathers together and everyone speaks in tongues, and outsiders or unbelievers enter, will they not say you are out of your minds?

verses.label: v24
verses.text: But if everyone prophesies and an unbeliever or outsider enters, that person is convicted by everyone and called to account by everyone.
lines: But if everyone prophesies and an unbeliever or outsider enters, that person is convicted by everyone and called to account by everyone.

verses.label: v25
verses.text: The secrets of that person's heart become evident, and so, falling facedown, the person will worship God and declare, “God is truly among you.”
lines: The secrets of that person's heart become evident, and so, falling facedown, the person will worship God and declare, “God is truly among you.”

verses.label: v26
verses.text: What then, brothers and sisters? When you gather, each one has a psalm, a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. Let everything be done for building up.
lines: What then, brothers and sisters? When you gather, each one has a psalm, a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. Let everything be done for building up.

verses.label: v27
verses.text: If anyone speaks in a tongue, let there be two, or at most three, each in turn, and let one person interpret.
lines: If anyone speaks in a tongue, let there be two, or at most three, each in turn, and let one person interpret.

verses.label: v28
verses.text: But if there is no interpreter, the speaker should remain silent in church and speak to oneself and to God.
lines: But if there is no interpreter, the speaker should remain silent in church and speak to oneself and to God.

verses.label: v29
verses.text: Let two or three prophets speak, and let the others discern what is said.
lines: Let two or three prophets speak, and let the others discern what is said.

verses.label: v30
verses.text: But if a revelation comes to another person who is seated, the first speaker should be silent.
lines: But if a revelation comes to another person who is seated, the first speaker should be silent.

verses.label: v31
verses.text: For you can all prophesy one by one, so that everyone may learn and everyone may be encouraged.
lines: For you can all prophesy one by one, so that everyone may learn and everyone may be encouraged.

verses.label: v32
verses.text: And prophets' spirits are subject to prophets,
lines: And prophets' spirits are subject to prophets,

verses.label: v33
verses.text: for God is not a God of disorder but of peace, as in all the churches of the saints.
lines: for God is not a God of disorder but of peace, as in all the churches of the saints.

verses.label: v34
verses.text: Women should remain silent in the churches, for they are not permitted to speak but should be in submission, as the law also says.
lines: Women should remain silent in the churches, for they are not permitted to speak but should be in submission, as the law also says.

verses.label: v35
verses.text: If they want to learn something, they should ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a woman to speak in church.
lines: If they want to learn something, they should ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a woman to speak in church.

verses.label: v36
verses.text: Or did God's word originate with you? Or did it reach only you?
lines: Or did God's word originate with you? Or did it reach only you?

verses.label: v37
verses.text: If anyone thinks they are a prophet or spiritual, that person should recognize that what I write to you is the Lord's command.
lines: If anyone thinks they are a prophet or spiritual, that person should recognize that what I write to you is the Lord's command.

verses.label: v38
verses.text: But if anyone refuses to recognize this, that person is not recognized.
lines: But if anyone refuses to recognize this, that person is not recognized.

verses.label: v39
verses.text: So then, my brothers and sisters, eagerly desire to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
lines: So then, my brothers and sisters, eagerly desire to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.

verses.label: v40
verses.text: But let everything be done properly and in an orderly way.
lines: But let everything be done properly and in an orderly way.

verses.text: For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the body's members, though many, are one body, so also is Christ.
lines: For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the body's members, though many, are one body, so also is Christ.

verses.label: v13
verses.text: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body—whether Jews or Greeks, enslaved or free—and we were all given one Spirit to drink.
lines: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body—whether Jews or Greeks, enslaved or free—and we were all given one Spirit to drink.

verses.label: v14
verses.text: For the body is not one member but many.
lines: For the body is not one member but many.

verses.label: v15
verses.text: If the foot says, “Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body,” that does not make it any less part of the body.
lines: If the foot says, “Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body,” that does not make it any less part of the body.

verses.label: v16
verses.text: And if the ear says, “Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body,” that does not make it any less part of the body.
lines: And if the ear says, “Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body,” that does not make it any less part of the body.

verses.label: v17
verses.text: If the whole body were an eye, where would hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the sense of smell be?
lines: If the whole body were an eye, where would hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the sense of smell be?

verses.label: v18
verses.text: But as it is, God arranged each one of the members in the body just as he wished.
lines: But as it is, God arranged each one of the members in the body just as he wished.

verses.label: v19
verses.text: If all were one member, where would the body be?
lines: If all were one member, where would the body be?

verses.label: v20
verses.text: But as it is, there are many members and one body.
lines: But as it is, there are many members and one body.

verses.label: v21
verses.text: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I do not need you,” nor again the head to the feet, “I do not need you.”
lines: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I do not need you,” nor again the head to the feet, “I do not need you.”

verses.label: v22
verses.text: On the contrary, the members of the body that seem weaker are indispensable,
lines: On the contrary, the members of the body that seem weaker are indispensable,

verses.label: v23
verses.text: and those members we consider less honorable we clothe with greater honor, while our unpresentable parts are treated with greater modesty.
lines: and those members we consider less honorable we clothe with greater honor, while our unpresentable parts are treated with greater modesty.

verses.label: v24
verses.text: Our presentable parts have no need of this. But God has composed the body, giving greater honor to the part that lacked it,
lines: Our presentable parts have no need of this. But God has composed the body, giving greater honor to the part that lacked it,

verses.label: v25
verses.text: so that there may be no division in the body but the members may have the same care for one another.
lines: so that there may be no division in the body but the members may have the same care for one another.

verses.label: v26
verses.text: If one member suffers, all the members suffer together; if one member is honored, all the members rejoice together.
lines: If one member suffers, all the members suffer together; if one member is honored, all the members rejoice together.

verses.label: v27
verses.text: Now you are Christ's body, and individually members of it.
lines: Now you are Christ's body, and individually members of it.

verses.label: v04

lines: Love is patient; love is kind. Love does not envy, does not boast, is not puffed up.

verses.label: v05
verses.text: It does not behave dishonorably, does not seek its own way, is not easily provoked, and does not keep an account of wrong.
lines: It does not behave dishonorably, does not seek its own way, is not easily provoked, and does not keep an account of wrong.

verses.label: v06
verses.text: It does not rejoice in injustice but rejoices together with the truth.
lines: It does not rejoice in injustice but rejoices together with the truth.

verses.label: v07
verses.text: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
lines: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

verses.label: v05
verses.text: But every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is one and the same as having her head shaved.
lines: But every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is one and the same as having her head shaved.

verses.label: v01
verses.text: I wish you would put up with a little foolishness from me. Indeed, do put up with me!
lines: I wish you would put up with a little foolishness from me. Indeed, do put up with me!

verses.label: v02
verses.text: For I am jealous for you with God's jealousy, because I promised you to one husband, to present you to Christ as a pure virgin.
lines: For I am jealous for you with God's jealousy, because I promised you to one husband, to present you to Christ as a pure virgin.

verses.label: v03
verses.text: But I fear that, just as the serpent deceived Eve by his cunning, your minds may be corrupted from sincere and pure devotion to Christ.
lines: But I fear that, just as the serpent deceived Eve by his cunning, your minds may be corrupted from sincere and pure devotion to Christ.

verses.label: v04
verses.text: For if someone comes proclaiming another Jesus whom we did not proclaim, or you receive a different spirit you did not receive, or a different gospel you did not accept, you put up with it well enough!
lines: For if someone comes proclaiming another Jesus whom we did not proclaim, or you receive a different spirit you did not receive, or a different gospel you did not accept, you put up with it well enough!

verses.label: v05
verses.text: For I consider myself in no way inferior to those “super-apostles.”
lines: For I consider myself in no way inferior to those “super-apostles.”

verses.label: v06
verses.text: Even if I am untrained in speech, I am not untrained in knowledge. In every way we have made this clear to you in all things.
lines: Even if I am untrained in speech, I am not untrained in knowledge. In every way we have made this clear to you in all things.

verses.label: v07
verses.text: Or did I commit a sin by humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I proclaimed God's gospel to you without charge?
lines: Or did I commit a sin by humbling myself so that you might be exalted, because I proclaimed God's gospel to you without charge?

verses.label: v08
verses.text: I robbed other churches by accepting support in order to serve you.
lines: I robbed other churches by accepting support in order to serve you.

verses.label: v09
verses.text: And when I was with you and in need, I did not burden anyone, for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied what I lacked. In everything I kept myself from being a burden to you, and I will continue to do so.
lines: And when I was with you and in need, I did not burden anyone, for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied what I lacked. In everything I kept myself from being a burden to you, and I will continue to do so.

verses.label: v10
verses.text: As surely as Christ's truth is in me, this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.
lines: As surely as Christ's truth is in me, this boasting of mine will not be silenced in the regions of Achaia.

verses.label: v11
verses.text: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do.
lines: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do.

verses.label: v12
verses.text: But what I do, I will continue to do, in order to cut off the opportunity from those who want an opportunity to be regarded as our equals in what they boast about.
lines: But what I do, I will continue to do, in order to cut off the opportunity from those who want an opportunity to be regarded as our equals in what they boast about.

verses.label: v13
verses.text: For such people are false apostles, deceitful workers, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.
lines: For such people are false apostles, deceitful workers, disguising themselves as apostles of Christ.

verses.label: v14
verses.text: And no wonder, for Satan himself disguises himself as an angel of light.
lines: And no wonder, for Satan himself disguises himself as an angel of light.

verses.label: v15
verses.text: So it is no great surprise if his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their works.
lines: So it is no great surprise if his servants also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their works.

verses.label: v16
verses.text: I say again: no one should think I am a fool. But if you do, then receive me even as a fool so that I too may boast a little.

verses.text: Because it was the day of preparation, the Judean leaders did not want the bodies to remain on the crosses during the Sabbath—especially since that Sabbath was a great day. So they asked Pilate to have the men’s legs broken and the bodies removed.

verses.text: But when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.

lines: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

verses.label: v36
verses.text: For these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of his bones will be broken.”
lines: For these things happened so that the Scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of his bones will be broken.”

verses.label: v37
verses.text: And another Scripture says, “They will look on the one they pierced.”
lines: And another Scripture says, “They will look on the one they pierced.”

verses.label: v38
verses.text: After these things, Joseph from Arimathea, who was secretly a disciple of Jesus because he feared the Judean leaders, asked Pilate for permission to take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave permission, so Joseph came and took his body.

lines: Because it was the Jewish day of preparation and the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.

lines: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She answered, “They have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they put him.”

verses.text: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of your inheritance— the place you made for your dwelling, LORD, the sanctuary your hands established, Lord.
lines: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of your inheritance—
the place you made for your dwelling, LORD,
the sanctuary your hands established, Lord.

verses.label: v18
verses.text: The LORD will reign forever and ever.”
lines: The LORD will reign forever and ever.”

verses.label: v01
verses.text: I heard a loud voice from the temple say to the seven angels, “Go and pour the seven bowls of God's fury onto the earth.”
lines: I heard a loud voice from the temple say to the seven angels, “Go and pour the seven bowls of God's fury onto the earth.”

verses.label: v02
verses.text: The first went and poured his bowl onto the earth. A foul and painful sore came upon the people who had the beast's mark and worshiped its image.
lines: The first went and poured his bowl onto the earth. A foul and painful sore came upon the people who had the beast's mark and worshiped its image.

verses.label: v03
verses.text: The second poured his bowl into the sea. It became blood like a dead person's, and every living being in the sea died.
lines: The second poured his bowl into the sea. It became blood like a dead person's, and every living being in the sea died.

verses.label: v04
verses.text: The third poured his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
lines: The third poured his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

verses.label: v05
verses.text: I heard the angel of the waters say: “You are righteous, the one who is and who was, the holy one, because you have judged these things.
lines: I heard the angel of the waters say:
“You are righteous, the one who is and who was, the holy one,
because you have judged these things.

verses.label: v06
verses.text: They poured out the blood of holy ones and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve it.”
lines: They poured out the blood of holy ones and prophets,
and you have given them blood to drink.
They deserve it.”

verses.label: v07
verses.text: I heard the altar say, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, your judgments are true and righteous.”
lines: I heard the altar say, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, your judgments are true and righteous.”

verses.label: v01
verses.text: I saw an angel coming down from heaven with the key to the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
lines: I saw an angel coming down from heaven with the key to the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

verses.label: v02
verses.text: He seized the dragon, the ancient serpent who is the Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.
lines: He seized the dragon, the ancient serpent who is the Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.

verses.label: v03
verses.text: He threw him into the abyss, shut it and sealed it over him, so that he would no longer lead the nations astray until the thousand years were completed. After that he must be released for a little while.
lines: He threw him into the abyss, shut it and sealed it over him, so that he would no longer lead the nations astray until the thousand years were completed. After that he must be released for a little while.

verses.label: v04
verses.text: I saw thrones, and those seated on them were given authority to judge. I also saw the souls of those beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and God's word, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image or received its mark on their foreheads or hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
lines: I saw thrones, and those seated on them were given authority to judge. I also saw the souls of those beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and God's word, and those who had not worshiped the beast or its image or received its mark on their foreheads or hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

verses.label: v05
verses.text: The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.
lines: The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were completed. This is the first resurrection.

verses.label: v06
verses.text: Blessed and holy is the one who shares in the first resurrection. The second death has no authority over them; they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with him for a thousand years.
lines: Blessed and holy is the one who shares in the first resurrection. The second death has no authority over them; they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with him for a thousand years.

verses.label: v07
verses.text: When the thousand years are completed, Satan will be released from his prison
lines: When the thousand years are completed, Satan will be released from his prison

verses.label: v08
verses.text: and will go out to lead astray the nations at the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them for battle. Their number is like the sand of the sea.
lines: and will go out to lead astray the nations at the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them for battle. Their number is like the sand of the sea.

verses.label: v09
verses.text: They spread over the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of the holy ones and the beloved city. Fire came down from heaven and devoured them.
lines: They spread over the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of the holy ones and the beloved city. Fire came down from heaven and devoured them.

verses.label: v10
verses.text: The devil who led them astray was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
lines: The devil who led them astray was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

verses.label: v11
verses.text: I saw a great white throne and the one seated on it. Earth and heaven fled from his face, and no place was found for them.
lines: I saw a great white throne and the one seated on it. Earth and heaven fled from his face, and no place was found for them.

verses.label: v12
verses.text: I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. Another book was opened, the book of life. The dead were judged according to their works from what was written in the books.
lines: I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. Another book was opened, the book of life. The dead were judged according to their works from what was written in the books.

verses.label: v13
verses.text: The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hades gave up their dead. Each was judged according to their works.
lines: The sea gave up its dead, and Death and Hades gave up their dead. Each was judged according to their works.

verses.label: v14
verses.text: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death: the lake of fire.
lines: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death: the lake of fire.

verses.label: v15
verses.text: Anyone not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
lines: Anyone not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.

verses.label: v19
verses.text: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth and their armies gathered to wage war against the rider on the horse and his army.
lines: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth and their armies gathered to wage war against the rider on the horse and his army.

verses.label: v20
verses.text: The beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who had performed signs in its presence, deceiving those who received the beast's mark and worshiped its image. The two were thrown alive into the lake of fire burning with sulfur.
lines: The beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who had performed signs in its presence, deceiving those who received the beast's mark and worshiped its image. The two were thrown alive into the lake of fire burning with sulfur.

verses.label: v21
verses.text: The rest were killed by the sword that came from the horseman's mouth, and all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.
lines: The rest were killed by the sword that came from the horseman's mouth, and all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.

verses.label: v01
verses.text: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.
lines: I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.

verses.label: v02
verses.text: I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
lines: I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

verses.label: v03
verses.text: I heard a loud voice from the throne say: “Look, God's tent is with humanity. He will dwell with them, and they will be his peoples, and God himself will be with them.
lines: I heard a loud voice from the throne say:
“Look, God's tent is with humanity.
He will dwell with them,
and they will be his peoples,
and God himself will be with them.

verses.label: v04
verses.text: He will wipe every tear from their eyes, and death will be no more. Grief, crying and pain will be no more, because the former things have passed away.”
lines: He will wipe every tear from their eyes,
and death will be no more.
Grief, crying and pain will be no more,
because the former things have passed away.”

verses.label: v01
verses.text: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.
lines: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

verses.label: v02
verses.text: He made the Sea of cast metal, round in shape, ten cubits from rim to rim and five cubits high. A measuring line thirty cubits long encircled it.
lines: He made the Sea of cast metal, round in shape, ten cubits from rim to rim and five cubits high. A measuring line thirty cubits long encircled it.

verses.label: v03
verses.text: Figures of oxen encircled it underneath, ten to a cubit, all around the Sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast in one piece with it.
lines: Figures of oxen encircled it underneath, ten to a cubit, all around the Sea. The oxen were in two rows, cast in one piece with it.

verses.label: v04
verses.text: It stood on twelve oxen: three facing north, three west, three south, and three east. The Sea rested above them, and all their hindquarters faced inward.
lines: It stood on twelve oxen: three facing north, three west, three south, and three east. The Sea rested above them, and all their hindquarters faced inward.

verses.label: v05
verses.text: It was a handbreadth thick. Its rim was shaped like the rim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It could hold three thousand baths.
lines: It was a handbreadth thick. Its rim was shaped like the rim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It could hold three thousand baths.

verses.label: v06
verses.text: He made ten basins, placing five on the right and five on the left, for washing. They rinsed the materials for the burnt offering in them, while the Sea was for the priests to wash in.
lines: He made ten basins, placing five on the right and five on the left, for washing. They rinsed the materials for the burnt offering in them, while the Sea was for the priests to wash in.

verses.label: v07
verses.text: He made ten gold lampstands according to their prescribed design and put them in the main hall, five on the right and five on the left.
lines: He made ten gold lampstands according to their prescribed design and put them in the main hall, five on the right and five on the left.

verses.label: v08
verses.text: He made ten tables and put them in the main hall, five on the right and five on the left. He also made a hundred gold sprinkling bowls.
lines: He made ten tables and put them in the main hall, five on the right and five on the left. He also made a hundred gold sprinkling bowls.

verses.label: v09
verses.text: He made the priests’ courtyard, the great courtyard, and doors for the courtyard, and overlaid the doors with bronze.
lines: He made the priests’ courtyard, the great courtyard, and doors for the courtyard, and overlaid the doors with bronze.

verses.label: v10
verses.text: He placed the Sea on the right side, toward the southeast.
lines: He placed the Sea on the right side, toward the southeast.

verses.label: v11
verses.text: Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished the work he did for King Solomon in God’s house:
lines: Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished the work he did for King Solomon in God’s house:

verses.label: v12
verses.text: the two pillars, the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars, and the two networks covering the two bowl-shaped capitals;
lines: the two pillars, the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars, and the two networks covering the two bowl-shaped capitals;

verses.label: v13
verses.text: the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, two rows of pomegranates for each network covering the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars;
lines: the four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, two rows of pomegranates for each network covering the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars;

verses.label: v14
verses.text: the stands and the basins he made on the stands;
lines: the stands and the basins he made on the stands;

verses.label: v15
verses.text: the one Sea and the twelve oxen beneath it;
lines: the one Sea and the twelve oxen beneath it;

verses.label: v16
verses.text: and the pots, shovels, forks, and all their utensils. Huram-abi made these of polished bronze for King Solomon for the LORD’s house.
lines: and the pots, shovels, forks, and all their utensils. Huram-abi made these of polished bronze for King Solomon for the LORD’s house.

verses.label: v17
verses.text: The king had them cast in the clay ground of the Jordan plain, between Succoth and Zeredah.
lines: The king had them cast in the clay ground of the Jordan plain, between Succoth and Zeredah.

verses.label: v18
verses.text: Solomon made all these utensils in such great quantities that the weight of the bronze was never determined.
lines: Solomon made all these utensils in such great quantities that the weight of the bronze was never determined.

verses.label: v19
verses.text: Solomon also made all the furnishings for God’s house: the gold altar, the tables on which the bread of the Presence was placed,
lines: Solomon also made all the furnishings for God’s house: the gold altar, the tables on which the bread of the Presence was placed,

verses.label: v20
verses.text: the lampstands and their lamps of pure gold, to burn as prescribed before the inner sanctuary,
lines: the lampstands and their lamps of pure gold, to burn as prescribed before the inner sanctuary,

verses.label: v21
verses.text: the flowers, lamps, and tongs of gold—the purest gold—
lines: the flowers, lamps, and tongs of gold—the purest gold—

verses.label: v22
verses.text: and the wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes, and firepans of pure gold. The entrances of the house—the inner doors to the Most Holy Place and the doors to the main hall—were gold.
lines: and the wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes, and firepans of pure gold. The entrances of the house—the inner doors to the Most Holy Place and the doors to the main hall—were gold.

verses.label: v13
verses.text: I am sending Huram-abi, a skilled man with understanding.
lines: I am sending Huram-abi, a skilled man with understanding.

verses.label: v14
verses.text: His mother is from the daughters of Dan, and his father is a man of Tyre. He knows how to work in gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, wood, purple, blue, fine linen, and crimson, and how to do every kind of engraving and devise any design assigned to him. He will work with your skilled workers and those of my lord David your father.
lines: His mother is from the daughters of Dan, and his father is a man of Tyre. He knows how to work in gold, silver, bronze, iron, stone, wood, purple, blue, fine linen, and crimson, and how to do every kind of engraving and devise any design assigned to him. He will work with your skilled workers and those of my lord David your father.

verses.label: v15
verses.text: Now let my lord send his servants the wheat, barley, oil, and wine he promised.
lines: Now let my lord send his servants the wheat, barley, oil, and wine he promised.

verses.label: v16
verses.text: We will cut as much timber from Lebanon as you need and bring it to you by sea in rafts to Joppa. You can take it up to Jerusalem.”
lines: We will cut as much timber from Lebanon as you need and bring it to you by sea in rafts to Joppa. You can take it up to Jerusalem.”

verses.label: v07
verses.text: David took the gold shields carried by Hadadezer’s servants and brought them to Jerusalem.
lines: David took the gold shields carried by Hadadezer’s servants and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.label: v08
verses.text: From Tibhath and Cun, towns belonging to Hadadezer, David took a vast quantity of bronze. Solomon used it to make the bronze Sea, the pillars, and the bronze utensils.
lines: From Tibhath and Cun, towns belonging to Hadadezer, David took a vast quantity of bronze. Solomon used it to make the bronze Sea, the pillars, and the bronze utensils.

verses.label: v09
verses.text: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah’s entire army,
lines: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah’s entire army,

verses.label: v10
verses.text: he sent his son Hadoram to King David to greet him and congratulate him for fighting Hadadezer and defeating him. Hadadezer had often been at war with Tou. Hadoram brought articles of gold, silver, and bronze.
lines: he sent his son Hadoram to King David to greet him and congratulate him for fighting Hadadezer and defeating him. Hadadezer had often been at war with Tou. Hadoram brought articles of gold, silver, and bronze.

verses.label: v11
verses.text: King David dedicated these to the LORD as well, along with the silver and gold he had taken from all the nations: Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, and Amalek.
lines: King David dedicated these to the LORD as well, along with the silver and gold he had taken from all the nations: Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, and Amalek.

verses.label: v24
verses.text: Under its rim, gourds encircled it, ten to a cubit. The gourds were in two rows, cast as one piece with the Sea.
lines: Under its rim, gourds encircled it, ten to a cubit. The gourds were in two rows, cast as one piece with the Sea.

verses.label: v26
verses.text: It was a handbreadth thick. Its rim was shaped like a cup’s rim, like a lily blossom. It held two thousand baths.
lines: It was a handbreadth thick. Its rim was shaped like a cup’s rim, like a lily blossom. It held two thousand baths.
